To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TssK forms transient higher order structures that are necessary for correct assembly of T6SS and its deployment toward a new target.
T6SS baseplate component TssK assembles de novo at the cell surface and its assembly dynamics are regulated by the T6SS regulatory module.
the baseplate component TssK forms transient higher-order structures in Pseudomonos aeruginosa, that are required for repositioning of the entire contractible apparatus and for T6SS deployment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamics of T6SS components in the bacterial cell envelope and the role of the TssE-TssK-TssB complex in this process.
the assembly and dynamics of TssK-containing structures, and how these structures are regulated by post-translational modifications.
the molecular mechanisms that govern the assembly and function of the T6SS in bacteria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
T6SS is a dynamic system with multiple regulatory checkpoints that ensure correct spatio-temporal assembly and deployment of the apparatus.
the TssK structure is the first step in the assembly of a functional T6SS apparatus and its dynamics are tightly controlled by the regulatory envelope module.

the assembly of the contractible T6SS apparatus in P. aerugionsa occurs in a step-wise manner and that TssK-containing structures are spatio-temporally regulated by the regulatory envelope module and are required for further recruitment of the contractile machinery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TssK structure serves as a spatio-temporal scaffold for assembly of the entire apparatus.
the TssK assembly dynamics in P. aerugenosa is regulated by the envelope sensor TagQ-TagQ and the T6SS kinase PpkA.
the baseplate component TssK is the first marker that is used by the bacteria for spatio-temporal assembly of T6SS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
assembly of the baseplate structure is not an irreversible step, and that the baseplate component can be re-used in the assembly of a new contractile apparatus.
the assembly of TssK-containing structures is a dynamic process that is dependent on the presence of competing bacteria, and is a prerequisite for the deployment of the contractile T6SS.
the assembly of the T6SS baseplate component TssK is a spatio-temporally regulated process and is not a simple consequence of the presence of T6SS components.
